description: AlembicAgent public API boundary policy. Exact package exports are the only supported consumer entrypoints; no wildcard, deep dist/src, or host-owned adapter imports are allowed.

forbiddenConsumerSpecifierSamples.reason: Aggregate tools subpath was retired in Train B IC3 after all consumers migrated to the @alembic/agent root facade; use the root facade or the fine-grained ./tools/runtime export.
Consumers must not import compiled package internals.
Consumers must not import source internals.
Only @alembic/agent/tools/runtime is public; router internals stay Agent-owned.
Terminal session internals were retired with the terminal public subpath; use @alembic/agent/tools/runtime for live terminal.exec.
Terminal capability/session/policy contracts were retired in E-3; live terminal.exec remains public through @alembic/agent/tools/runtime.
Service internals and host adapters must not become package subpaths.
Consumers use the curated strict Plan facade, not run-family or implementation paths.
Strict implementation, repair authority, stage builders, and prompt internals remain Agent-owned behind the curated production facade.
Judge calibration and evaluator implementation internals are not Main consumer contracts.
Frozen fixture runners and provider internals stay private to Agent evaluation.
